blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian has urged the Department of Education (DepEd) to ensure that its protocols for the looming super El Niño protect students without worsening learning loss, stressing the need for localized rather than blanket class suspensions. “El Niño not only threatens the safety of students, but also their ability to learn. We must ensure that our students’ knowledge does not decline because this will worsen our education crisis,” Gatchalian said in a statement on Sunday.
